detail.longDescription: My calendar basically dictates how I spend each and every moment of my work day. It helps me prioritize my tasks, prepare for meetings, and lets me know when I have downtime to get specific things done. But none of that is possible—or as streamlined—without the help of automation. From cross-posting events to my different calendars (I have several) to blocking out time in my calendar for specific projects, Zapier helps me stay on top of my schedule.
